newsitem.title: FINLAND: KEMIRA TO GRANULATE CHEMICAL FOR EXPORTS.
newsitem.headline: KEMIRA TO GRANULATE CHEMICAL FOR EXPORTS.

text.p: Finnish chemicals and fertiliser group Kemira Oy said in a statement on Wednesday it would invest 25 million markka to start granulating polyaluminium chloride which is used in water purifiers.
"A granulated product improves the export market of the water treatment chemical," Kemira said.
The investment would be made at the plant in Helsingborg, Sweden, and the capacity of the granulation plant would be 20,000 tonnes per year.
Kemira said it would also increase the feedstock of polyaluminium chloride at the plant.
Polyaluminium chloride -- used as a coagulant in water purification -- is normally delivered as a solution which raises transport costs, it said.
A solid product would make possible more distant exports, for instance to Thailand, Africa and the Middle East, Kemira said.
